title: North American Management Corp Sells 710 Shares of Apple (AAPL)

text:
Posted by Lisa Pomrenke on Apr 15th, 2018 // No Comments 
North American Management Corp trimmed its position in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.6% in the 4th quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The fund owned 120,135 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 710 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 3.1% of North American Management Corp’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 8th largest holding. North American Management Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $20,330,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
Several other hedge funds have also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the business. Foster & Motley Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.2% during the fourth quarter. Foster & Motley Inc. now owns 94,510 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $15,994,000 after acquiring an additional 1,113 shares in the last quarter. Palo Capital Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 7.8% during the fourth quarter. Palo Capital Inc. now owns 29,622 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,013,000 after acquiring an additional 2,153 shares in the last quarter. Reinhart Partners Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 45.1% during the fourth quarter. Reinhart Partners Inc. now owns 4,896 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $829,000 after acquiring an additional 1,522 shares in the last quarter. Hendershot Investments Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.1% during the fourth quarter. Hendershot Investments Inc. now owns 92,473 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $15,649,000 after acquiring an additional 969 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Augustine Asset Management Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 4.1% during the fourth quarter. Augustine Asset Management Inc. now owns 82,630 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $13,983,000 after acquiring an additional 3,217 shares in the last quarter. 61.36% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. 
Shares of AAPL opened at $174.73 on Friday. Apple has a 52-week low of $140.45 and a 52-week high of $183.50. The firm has a market capitalization of $883,588.63, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.97, a P/E/G ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same period last year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. sell-side analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current fiscal year. 
AAPL has been the topic of several recent analyst reports. Bank of America downgraded shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and upped their price objective for the company from $180.00 to $220.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 17th. Cascend Securities upped their price objective on shares of Apple from $200.00 to $220.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, January 29th. Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $205.00 price target (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 23rd. Rosenblatt Securities reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, January 19th. Finally, Zacks Investment Research upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $190.00 price target on the stock in a report on Wednesday, January 3rd. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $203.21. 
In other Apple news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . 0.08% of the stock is owned by company insiders. 
About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
